test_variants_decorator: test a function with jax jit and pmap variants using chex.variants decorator
test_all_variants_decorator: test a function with all jax execution variants enabled using chex.all_variants decorator
generate_params_product: generate a cartesian product of parameter lists for parameterized test cases

apply_pmap_variant: apply jax pmap to a function with device broadcasting and reduction support
